revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, showing a utility-room passage with cabinets, conduits, inspection access panels, large neutral floor and wall tiles, and warm practical interior lighting. Right-oblique view, medium-wide framing, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. A middle-aged woman with a sturdy build, wearing dark work trousers and a muted green jacket with brown and cream clothing tones, is lying flat on her stomach on the floor with arms and legs spread naturally, body axis horizontal. Scene is clearly staged and calm, with no signs of injury, distress, emergency, medical activity, or violence. Composition should look like a plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, with the subject clearly visible and a column or partition partly framing one side of the image. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, non-cinematic, no text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or annotation.
